acceptance: The CLI reference documents compare exit codes 0 to 4, results validate with exit 5, and the guard with its flag, environment variable and exit 6, including its limits.
The result-format reference lists environment.host_load and execution.billable_platform_acknowledgement.
The site docs check passes and the PR is merged to the site's next branch.
context:
Site repository BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site; follow its AGENTS.md. Facts come from PR 4203 and the code on develop, not from memory.

Progress (2026-11-14): documented in https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site/pull/157, merged to the site's next branch, which deploys only when next is merged into main at the next core release pin. Behaviour verified on develop: compare 0/3/4/1/2, results validate 5 and 1, guard exit 6 for run and compare, MCP refusal RESOURCE_ACCESS_DENIED. Remaining: changes from the credentials, submit-gate and run-official branches once they merge. This item stays open until those are documented.

Also to document (from PR #4227, merged 2026-11-14): run --force per-value deletion text, platforms install prints instructions only, run-official --acknowledge-billable-platform, the driver auto-install gate (exit 6, BENCHBOX_DRIVER_AUTO_INSTALL) and the list of paths the guard does not cover (see core docs/operations/run-safety.md).

Also to document (from PR #4228): MCP runs now use the same default compression and registered platform defaults as the CLI.

Also to document (from PR #4229): plaintext credential storage, file modes and ${VAR} references (platforms/snowflake.md, usage/troubleshooting.md); the hosted-submission acknowledgement; the maintainer-run label gate (breaking: publish run now needs --label or BENCHBOX_ALLOW_MAINTAINER_LABEL=1).
description: Core PR https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/pull/4203 changed user-facing CLI behaviour, including a breaking change to compare's exit codes and a new refusal for non-interactive cloud runs. The site documentation does not yet describe them. The needed text is in the PR body.
